rationale: The papers 'Evidence for Cosmic Acceleration Is Robust to Observed Correlations between Type Ia Supernova Luminosity and Stellar Age' and 'The Effect of Environment on Type Ia Supernovae in the Dark Energy Survey Three-Year Cosmological Sample' provide insights into the correlations affecting Type Ia supernova luminosities, which are relevant to understanding the estimation of cosmological parameters.
